description: This file defines the `PhpInputStream` class, which extends a `Stream` class to provide a caching wrapper around the PHP input stream (`php://input`). It supports reading and converting the stream contents to string with caching, and indicates that the stream is not writable.

classes.name: PhpInputStream
classes.description: A class that wraps the PHP input stream (`php://input`) and caches its contents for multiple reads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the stream, defaults to using `php://input` as the stream source.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire stream content as a string, utilizing cache if already read.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream, caching the read content.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves remaining contents of the stream, up to a maximum length, and caches it.
